nodes.description: Public token name string set in the constructor to 'Tesla Capital Corp'.
Public token symbol string set in the constructor to 'TeslaCapital'.
Public uint8 decimals value set in the constructor to 10.
Public uint256 total token supply, initialized to 55555555550000000000.
Mapping(address => uint) holding token balances of every account.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) holding ERC20 allowances.
Constructor of TeslaCapital: initializes name, symbol, decimals, _totalSupply and credits msg.sender with the whole supply.
View function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
View function returning balances[tokenOwner].
View function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Transfers tokens by decrementing sender balance and incrementing recipient balance using safeSub/safeAdd.
Transfers tokens on behalf of 'from', decrementing balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender] and incrementing balances[to].
SafeMath addition helper performing c = a + b with require(c >= a).
SafeMath subtraction helper performing require(b <= a) then c = a - b.
SafeMath multiplication helper performing c = a * b with require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath division helper performing require(b > 0) then c = a / b.
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner and allowance owner throughout the token contract.
balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens) inside transfer: state-mutating arithmetic on the sender balance.
balances[from] = safeSub(balances[from], tokens) inside transferFrom: state-mutating arithmetic on an arbitrary 'from' balance.
allowed[from][msg.sender] = safeSub(allowed[from][msg.sender], tokens) inside transferFrom: state-mutating arithmetic on an allowance.
_totalSupply - balances[address(0)] inside totalSupply: raw subtraction performed without the SafeMath helper.
Input parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf(address tokenOwner).
Input parameter spender of approve(address spender, uint tokens).
Input parameter tokens of approve(address spender, uint tokens).
Input parameter to of transfer(address to, uint tokens).
Input parameter tokens of transfer(address to, uint tokens).
Input parameter from of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens).
Input parameter to of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens).
Input parameter tokens of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens).
Input parameter a of safeAdd(uint a, uint b).
Input parameter b of safeAdd(uint a, uint b).
Local return variable c holding a + b in safeAdd.
Named return local 'balance' of balanceOf(address tokenOwner).
Named return local 'remaining' of allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender).
Named return local 'success' of approve(address spender, uint tokens).

edges.reason: msg.sender is trusted with the entire initial supply in the constructor and is stored into balances.
msg.sender determines the allowance owner written in approve.
msg.sender is the account whose balance is debited in transfer.
msg.sender is used as the spender index of allowed[from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
Constructor writes the name state variable.
Constructor writes the symbol state variable.
Constructor writes the decimals state variable.
Constructor initializes _totalSupply.
Constructor credits balances[msg.sender] with _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)].
The raw subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] is performed in totalSupply without SafeMath.
_totalSupply is an operand of the unprotected subtraction in totalSupply.
balances[address(0)] is an operand of the unprotected subtraction in totalSupply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transfer mutates the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping for from and to.
transferFrom mutates allowed[from][msg.sender].
transfer executes the balance subtraction wrapped in safeSub.
transferFrom executes the balance subtraction on the from account.
transferFrom executes the allowance subtraction for msg.sender.
balances[msg.sender] is read and written by the subtraction in transfer.
balances[from] is read and written by the subtraction in transferFrom.
allowed[from][msg.sender] is read and written by the subtraction in transferFrom.
transfer calls safeSub to guard the balance decrement.
transfer calls safeAdd to guard the balance increment.
transferFrom calls safeSub twice for balance and allowance decrements.
transferFrom calls safeAdd for the recipient balance increment.
tokenOwner indexes balances in balanceOf.
spender indexes the allowed mapping in approve.
tokens is the allowance amount stored by approve.
to is the recipient credited in transfer.
tokens is the amount moved in transfer.
tokens is the subtrahend of the balance subtraction in transfer.
from is the debited account in transferFrom.
to is the credited account in transferFrom.
tokens is the amount moved in transferFrom.
tokens is the subtrahend of balances[from] in transferFrom.
tokens is the subtrahend of the allowance in transferFrom.
a is the first operand of the addition in safeAdd.
b is the second operand of the addition in safeAdd.
c holds the arithmetic result checked by require(c >= a) in safeAdd.

normalization_plan.reason: tokenOwner is only an index argument of balanceOf and carries no semantics beyond that call.
spender is only used as the allowance key inside approve.
tokens is only the allowance value written by approve.
to is only the recipient key of the balances mapping in transfer.
tokens is only the amount subtracted/added in transfer.
from is only the debited account key in transferFrom.
to is only the credited account key in transferFrom.
tokens is only the amount moved by transferFrom.
a is a purely local operand of the addition helper safeAdd.
b is a purely local operand of the addition helper safeAdd.
c is the temporary result variable of safeAdd and never persists state.
balance is the named return slot of balanceOf.
remaining is the named return slot of allowance.
success is the named return slot of approve.
